title: The One More Rep Lie
premise: A gym bro insists he has one rep left, but his body has already clocked out.
hook: A muscular stickman confidently loads one absurdly oversized plate onto a barbell.
setup: He tells his spotter he only needs one more rep.
escalation: He gives a confident thumbs-up while his legs shake.
The spotter adds encouragement; the bar sinks a little further.
The lifter's arms tremble and his expression changes from smug to terrified.
punchline: He escapes the weight by casually pretending the set is over, then immediately asks for another plate.

characters.description: Original muscular stickman gym regular; oversized rounded shoulders and arms, small simple head, expressive eyebrows, off-white body fill and thick irregular black outline.
Slimmer stickman gym partner with simple oval head, long limbs and a deadpan expression; same ink outline and off-white fill.

shots.framing: Low-angle medium shot on barbell and BRO
shots.action: BRO confidently slaps an oversized plate onto one end of the bar; the bar dips under the weight.
shots.prop_state: Bar has one oversized plate on each side; bench is centered.
shots.background: Minimal gym with muted olive-grey wall and blue-grey bench.

shots.action: BRO lowers himself under the bar and grips it; SPOTTER steps into position behind the bench.
shots.prop_state: Bar rests above BRO's chest; plates remain fixed.

shots.framing: Close-up on BRO's hands and bar
shots.action: BRO pushes; the bar rises only a few centimetres, then stops dead.
shots.prop_state: Bar flexes slightly; plates wobble but do not fall.

shots.action: BRO turns his eyes toward SPOTTER and gives a trembling thumbs-up without moving the bar.
SPOTTER leans in to help; BRO's legs begin bicycling in the air as if running away.
shots.transition: Fast cut on first leg kick.

shots.framing: Extreme close-up on BRO's eyes and trembling mouth
shots.action: BRO's eyes widen; a sweat drop slides down as the bar dips a little.
shots.prop_state: Bar lowers slightly but remains supported; no injury shown.

shots.action: BRO suddenly slides out from under the bar as if nothing happened, stands and dusts his hands; SPOTTER catches the bar.
shots.expression: BRO instantly smug again; SPOTTER deadpan.
shots.prop_state: Bar safely supported on rack; plates remain on bar.
shots.transition: Hard cut timed to the bar rack clank.

shots.action: BRO points at the bar and confidently signals for another plate; SPOTTER slowly looks directly at camera.
shots.expression: BRO completely serious; SPOTTER exhausted disbelief.
shots.prop_state: Bar racked, ready for more weight.
shots.transition: Hold on SPOTTER's look for punchline.

audio.voiceover: Optional short dialogue: BRO: 'One more rep.' SPOTTER: 'You said that five minutes ago.'
